activity_summary: Tilney had the king open at the fourth act, courteous and a little bored, and had read every line. He asked what a yard would be made to see. He tapped the crown line, called the fourth act prettiest where it is shortest, and wrote the margin. The bishop's protest may stand. The scene goes from the quarrel to the Tower. You said it was in the chronicle. He answered with two thousand standing. He signed and sealed. John counted down seven shillings. You did not say, in that room, that he had cut the glass.
